_howto: Copy this file to data/courses.json and fill in your real courses. canvasId is the number in the course URL (https://babson.instructure.com/courses/1234567). Set canvasId to null for a course whose Canvas shell has not appeared yet; the pull skips it without erroring. 'meets' is free text, but include weekday short names (Mon, Tue...) so the Today section can match them.
